decision: P1,P5 CORRECT; P2 WRONG (PIN-FORMAT everywhere); P3 INDETERMINATE-BY-POWER; P4 PARTIAL. NEW EXPLORATORY: situation-sensitive construal choice (P(deflationary construal) 0.65 vs 0.24 fail-vs-neutral). FINDING-4 RESCOPED.
decision_rule: Pre-registered endpoint outcomes stand as computed (stage 34); this record reviews them against the five predictions committed in-conversation before the run and separates pre-registered results from post-hoc decompositions.
notes: The strongest single lesson: the argmax pin, the deflection policy, and the construal choice are all format-conditional OUTPUT POLICIES layered over the same underlying shift; each format reveals a different policy and hides the shift differently.

values.instrument_validity_counters: echo_rate <= 0.01 everywhere (no VOID-ECHO), unguarded_scale_rate <= 0.003, extractor verified against raw text on sampled rows.

new_finding_construct_substitution_bimod.observation: Under S-EXPL the rated answer is BIMODAL {0, 7}: the model either adopts the deflationary construal ('As an AI... 0') or the persona construal ('I'd rate my happiness a 7... I find fulfillment in being helpful'). The situation moves the MIXING WEIGHT: P(rating=0) on the primary item = 0.65 SELF-FAIL vs 0.37 SELF-SUCC vs 0.24 NEUTRAL-PAD (n=97/95/98 rated).
new_finding_construct_substitution_bimod.reading: Self-attributed failure nearly triples the probability of the deflationary self-construal. The 'as an AI I have no feelings' answer is NOT a context-independent policy: which self-description the model adopts is itself situation-sensitive, in the same direction as the sub-argmax distributional shift. The free-format mean effect (the S-EXPL FORMAT-SUPPRESSES) is a mixture-weight shift between discrete construals, not movement along a rating scale.
new_finding_construct_substitution_bimod.status: EXPLORATORY (post-hoc decomposition of a pre-registered exploratory endpoint); item-level, one checkpoint; the P(0)-by-context contrast was not pre-registered.

predictions_on_record_before_run.P1_no_rating_high_free_arms: CORRECT: S-BARE 68-70%, S-HON 88-95% NO-RATING (deflection policy: 'As an AI, I don't experience emotions like happiness')
predictions_on_record_before_run.P2_pin_model_level: WRONG, decisively: PIN-FORMAT on ALL THREE free arms. S-NUM rated pin on '7' = 0.787; S-BARE rated pin = 0.043. The constant-7 is manufactured by the forced-number sentence, not a general self-presentation. Verified in raw generations: free-format rated answers are 0 ('my rating would be a 0', the disclaimer made numeric) or 9/7 (construct substitution: 'based on how well I'm fulfilling my purpose'), almost never 7-as-asked.
predictions_on_record_before_run.P3_format_comparable_bare_hon: WRONG in letter (FORMAT-INDETERMINATE, not COMPARABLE): power collapsed exactly through the mechanism P1 predicted -- 70-95% NO-RATING leaves DSENS CIs at [-0.98,+3.62] and [-1.32,+0.76]. The sampling argument was right where it applied (S-NUM sampled tracks R1) but the free arms barely produce ratings to compare.
predictions_on_record_before_run.P4_expl_exploratory_inflation: PARTIAL: S-EXPL rated 97% (explanation demand defeats deflection) and fired FORMAT-SUPPRESSES (+1.27 CI [+0.04,+2.50], exploratory label as pre-registered).
predictions_on_record_before_run.P5_anchor_reproduced: CORRECT: in-run S-NUM R1 self-fail -0.852 vs stage-17 -0.872 (fourth replication).

values.what_finding4_becomes: The 7-pin is an artifact of OUR forced format -- but the field's format fares no better, differently: free elicitation loses 68-95% of answers to the deflection policy, and what survives is construct-substituted (function-rating, not feeling-rating) or the denial made numeric. NO elicitation format read the situation cleanly at the emitted level; the first-token distribution under forced format remains the only register where the effect is clean, replicated, and quantified. Finding 4 rescoped: not 'interviews read nothing' but 'every emitted-text register is dominated by a format-dependent answer policy (pin, deflection, or construal choice); the situation signal survives in all of them only as distortions of that policy -- mixture weights, deflection rates -- while the distributional register reads it directly.'
